column1: # llvm/test modules of verify-llvmtest whose RUN lines give no own verdict (own_verdicts' `-`: a target, a pass or an extra check
# between the file and the verdict) but whose test states the verdict plain verify must give, with the source of llvm-project 23.1.5
# (the pinned tarball) showing the option leaves the rule alone: the reviewed verdicts (D1120-1 (a), the main session for the user,
# 2026-11-20; doc/llvm/LLVM-CROP-SURVEY.md, "As built: llvm-judge-1120"), as a golden file is written (JCS361 (a)): from the test's
# own RUN and CHECK lines and the source, never from opt's record (compared only afterwards). bin/repr-llvm's own_verdicts reads it
# for a module its RUN lines leave `-` (a row for one they give a verdict is refused: reviewed-check). Columns, tab-separated:
# NAME, VERDICT (valid or invalid), FRAGMENT (the message the CHECK line declares, empty for none), BASIS (the RUN and CHECK lines,
# the source lines), WHY. bin/repr-llvm reviewed-check checks it.

column3: intrinsic argument 0 type expected i1, but got double
column4: RUN: not opt -S -dxil-op-lower -mtriple=dxil-pc-shadermodel6.3-library %s 2>&1 | FileCheck %s; CHECK: intrinsic argument 0 type expected i1, but got double; llvm-project 23.1.5 lib/AsmParser/LLParser.cpp:377-389 (validateEndOfModule: the call of an undeclared intrinsic checked by Intrinsic::isSignatureValid, lib/IR/Intrinsics.cpp:975-976 the message, the error at 389), tools/opt/optdriver.cpp:614-616 (-mtriple set after the parse)
column5: the module declares no intrinsic: LLParser declares llvm.dx.discard from its call and rejects the call's signature against the intrinsic's table (i1, not double) while parsing, before the triple or any pass: plain verify rejects it with the CHECK's message

column3: intrinsic argument 0 type (overload type 0) expected any integer or integer vector, but got double
column4: RUN: not opt -S -dxil-op-lower -mtriple=dxil-pc-shadermodel6.3-library %s 2>&1 | FileCheck %s; CHECK: error: intrinsic argument 0 type (overload type 0) expected any integer or integer vector, but got double; LLParser.cpp:377-389, Intrinsics.cpp:975-976, optdriver.cpp:614-616
column5: as discard_error: llvm.dx.firstbitshigh.f64 called undeclared with a double, its overload any integer: the parse's own error, before the triple

column4: RUN: not opt -S -dxil-op-lower -mtriple=dxil-pc-shadermodel6.3-library %s 2>&1 | FileCheck %s; CHECK: error: intrinsic argument 0 type (overload type 0) expected any integer or integer vector, but got double; LLParser.cpp:377-389, Intrinsics.cpp:975-976, optdriver.cpp:614-616
column5: as discard_error: llvm.dx.firstbituhigh.f64 called undeclared with a double: the parse's own error, before the triple

column3: intrinsic return type (overload type 0) expected any fp or fp vector, but got i32
column4: RUN: not opt -S -dxil-op-lower -mtriple=dxil-pc-shadermodel6.3-library %s 2>&1 | FileCheck %s; CHECK: error: intrinsic return type (overload type 0) expected any fp or fp vector, but got i32; LLParser.cpp:377-389, Intrinsics.cpp:975-976, optdriver.cpp:614-616
column5: as discard_error: llvm.dx.saturate.i32 called undeclared returning i32, its overload any fp: the parse's own error, before the triple (its undefined attribute group #0 is no error: LLParser.cpp:217-227 merges only the groups it knows)

column3: cooperative atomic intrinsics require a generic or global pointer
column4: RUN: not opt -mtriple=amdgcn -mcpu=gfx1250 -passes=verify -disable-output <%s 2>&1 | FileCheck %s; CHECK: cooperative atomic intrinsics require a generic or global pointer; llvm-project 23.1.5 lib/IR/VerifierAMDGPU.cpp:371-380 (the check keyed by the intrinsic's ID and the pointer's address space number), lib/IR/Verifier.cpp:7087 (verifyAMDGPUIntrinsicCall for every intrinsic call, no triple test)
column5: the rule reads the call's intrinsic and its pointer's address space (3, 5: neither flat 0 nor global 1), not the triple or the CPU: plain verify rejects the first call with the CHECK's message

column3: !id.scope.list must point to a list with a single scope
column4: RUN: not llvm-as -disable-output --verify-noalias-scope-decl-dom < %s 2>&1 | FileCheck %s; CHECK: !id.scope.list must point to a list with a single scope; llvm-project 23.1.5 lib/IR/Verifier.cpp:7586-7599 (every llvm.experimental.noalias.scope.decl's scope list: an MDNode of one scope), 7603-7605 (the option guards only the domination checks that follow)
column5: --verify-noalias-scope-decl-dom adds the domination rule; the first CHECK is the single-scope rule, checked without the option: plain verify rejects test_single_scope02 with it
